title: fix(post): name the Agie post "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)"
body:
This PR builds on #4003 (issue #3996), which is merged. The branch started on the #4003 branch and then took `git merge origin/main`. The own commits are f6f40a28a and 1b080d420 (the #4022 review fixes); 028530986 is the merge of `main`.

## Decision

The contributor and the maintainer agreed the name on Discord on 25 Nov 2026. The post that writes AgieVision ISO, SBR and SBL job files for the AGIECUT Classic 2S is now "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)". Its refusals say "The Agie Wire EDM job requires ...". The record is `docs/decisions/4000-agie-wire-edm-name.md`.

## What changed, by class (issue #4000)

**B. Agie-specific texts with a generic name: renamed.**
- The post name `posting::agie::POST`: "Native wire EDM job files" -> "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)".
- `assets/posts/agie-native.cps`: the description, the `onOpen` refusal and the option group "Wire EDM technology" -> "AgieVision technology". The line count and the `throw` column do not change.
- 45 refusal and UI texts in 11 source files (and three module comments):
  - `crates/app/src`: `operation/agie_profile.rs` (21), `posting_agie.rs` (12), `posting.rs`, `posting_mounts.rs`, `posting_per_op.rs`, `posting_agie_group.rs` (1 each);
  - `crates/geometry/src/die_opening.rs` (1);
  - `crates/ui/src`: `post_dialog.rs` (2), `post_dialog_tabs.rs` (3: "AgieVision job files (ISO, SBR, SBL)", "the AgieVision control" two times), `state.rs` (1), `wire_page.rs` (the open-cut hint: "The Agie Wire EDM job requires both clamps ...").
- The `.mch` description of `agiecut-classic-2s.mch`.
- The 17 scripts in `examples/agie/` (`cps: "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)"`).
- `docs/user-guide/agie-wire-edm.md`, `site/content/guide/check-and-post/posting.md`, `site/content/guide/operations/operations-edm.md`.
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (a process file).

**C. Generic items with an Agie name.**
- The Wire page open-cut rows and the inspection controls: #4003 shows them only for Agie jobs. This PR renames only the hint text.
- `CommandKind::ImportAgieDrawing` -> `ImportInspectionDrawing` (an internal UI enum; it runs a plain DXF import). No MCP tool, CLI command or script verb changes.
- The old-name alias logic (`LEGACY_POST`, `current_name`, `current_ref`, `current_key`) moved out of `posting_agie.rs` into a new generic table `posting::aliases` (`crates/app/src/posting_aliases.rs`, `POST_ALIASES`). The project loader (`project/apply.rs`, `project/mount_dto.rs`), the option-key normalizer (`schema.rs`), `SelectPost`, `SetSetupPost`, `resolve_cps`, the post offer and the machine post check call it. No generic module calls `posting::agie` to resolve a post name.

**D. Stale documents.**
- `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`: the wire section says that `WIRE_POSTS` has four entries, and has a new `agie-native.cps` paragraph.
- `site/content/guide/check-and-post/machines.md`: the wire row lists "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)" and the AGIECUT Classic 2S template.

## Compatibility

- Both old names stay hidden aliases: "Agie native wire EDM" (#3537) and "Native wire EDM job files". The table applies to the document post and the setup post in a project file, the option keys `builtin:<name>`, `SelectPost` and `SetSetupPost`, the script `cps:` value, the MCP post tools, the CLI and the machine `controller.post` value.
- A save writes the new name. The project file version does not change.
- Not changed: the condition ids, the MCP tool names, the CLI command, the module names, the golden folder names, and the script receipt value `"format": "Agie native wire EDM"`.
- The site anchor changes to `#agie-wire-edm-agievision`. The one link to the old anchor (`posting.md`) is updated.
- Old names still load, so this is not a breaking change.

## Screenshots (review item 1)

Before: `origin/main` 3bb6647f6. After: the PR head (the UI code is the same in 028530986 and 1b080d420). A temporary ignored kittest test saved `h.render()`; it is not committed. The images are only on the fork branch `pr-screenshots`, folder `pr-4022/`.

The folder picker title ("Choose a parent folder for the Agie Wire EDM job") is a native window. The harness cannot render it.

## Goldens

- The posted job goldens do not change.
- Only line 2 of the 11 `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/agie-native/*.refusal` files changes (the `.cps` refusal text). The `(user.cps:16:9)` location does not change.

## Pinning tests

All in existing suites. `crates/app/tests/wire_post_alias.rs`:
- `the_new_name_is_listed_and_the_old_names_are_not` (pins the post list name);
- `the_alias_table_resolves_both_old_names`;
- `each_old_name_selects_the_new_post_by_command_script_and_lookup`;
- `a_project_saved_with_each_old_name_opens_and_saves_the_new_name` (the open, the option key and the save);
- `an_option_map_under_each_old_key_normalizes_to_the_new_key`;
- `no_source_text_names_the_post_native_wire_edm` (the "Done means" text search of `crates/app/src`, `crates/ui/src`, `crates/geometry/src` and `agie-native.cps`; the alias table and the receipt value are the two kept lines).

The posting round-trip for a legacy project (review item 2) is in the `agie_native` suite, because the control-checked punch fixture and the job goldens are there. `crates/app/tests/agie_native/legacy_name.rs`:
- `a_project_saved_with_each_old_name_posts_the_unchanged_job_and_saves_the_new_name`. For each old name ("Agie native wire EDM" and "Native wire EDM job files"), the test saves the punch with the old name as the post and in the option key. It opens that file in a new world and posts it to a new temporary directory, with no per-run option override. It compares `CCSEP20.ISO`, `CCSEP20.SBR` and `CCSEP20.SBL` byte for byte with the unchanged goldens in `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/`. Then it saves again and checks that the file has the new name and no old name.

Refusal texts pinned: `crates/app/tests/agie_native.rs` ("Agie Wire EDM jobs require default post options and One program output"), `plasma_post_refusals.rs` and `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs` (the `.cps` refusal), `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/agie_post.rs` (the dialog texts, plus the new pin of "A new job folder will contain the AgieVision job files (ISO, SBR, SBL).").
`mcp_wire_contour.rs` checks that SKILL.md lists no alias name from `POST_ALIASES`.

The ui `#[test]` count does not go down. No snapshot PNG changes.

## Gate (macOS, final head 1b080d420)

Log first line `HEAD 1b080d4202cda0ae6cc6bec3d318b37830c0ed40`, `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1`, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: the geometry change makes quick fall back to batch. 1215 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 57.2 min, exit 0. This includes `app suites: agie_native` (with `legacy_name`), `wire_post_alias`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `ui suites: lib` and `clippy -D warnings`.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- Strict clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exit 0. The commit changes no ui code.
- P7, not under the safety floor: no heavy step.

The earlier gate of 028530986 ran on Windows (winbuild): batch fallback 1215 steps, 0 failed; light 6 steps, 0 failed.

## Not exercised

- No run on an AgieVision control: the job files do not change.
- The site build (Zola) did not run. The new anchor follows the default slug of the heading.

Changelog: The AgieVision post is now named "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)", and its refusals say "The Agie Wire EDM job requires ...". Projects, scripts and MCP calls with the old names "Agie native wire EDM" and "Native wire EDM job files" still open and post; a save writes the new name.

Process change: yes

Effort: medium
